Morally acceptable actions are those that are fair, just, and considerate. On one hand, the teacher's policy ensures that all students are held to the same standard. Therefore, the action of not accepting any excuses might be morally unacceptable because it lacks compassion and doesn't allow for individual circumstances to be considered.
